title: dryopteris marginalis f. elegans
intro: Dryopteris marginalis f. elegans, commonly known as the elegant marginal shield fern, is a subspecies of the marginal shield fern (Dryopteris marginalis), a type of fern native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Dryopteris marginalis f. elegans include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce pain. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
